question: Did you read CLAUDE.md? If not, explain the reason in detail in the answer field. If yes, also state that you read it in the answer field.
answer: Yes, I read CLAUDE.md (root directory, full text via the Read tool, lines 1-712 of 1076) in this final review pass before re-reading background.md, index.json, and checklist.json fresh. It gave me the baseline understanding of the INIT->INIT_CHECK gate mechanics, the story lifecycle, owner-lease/agent-dispatch-registry architecture, and command-policy/process-fact-registry wiring conventions referenced throughout this story. I then used it as the baseline to verify (via grep/sed against the actual source files) the six previously-corrected SRC citations (proofstory.ts:887/916, lifecycle-registry.ts:849, verify-process-fact-contract.mjs :160/:1013/:1229/:1265, lifecycle-registry-contract.ts checkProcessFactLifecycle() ~:150, the six-vs-thirteen count reconciliation, and the RED gloss in Key Insights) plus the still-load-bearing citations (cli-engine.ts:1372, lifecycle-registry.ts:599, types.ts:69, agent-dispatch-registry.ts:435/504, command-catalog-smoke.ts:102-109, spec sections 1.1.3/3.3/4.1) -- all confirmed accurate against current source. In the course of this verification I found three new, previously-unflagged imprecisions (recorded as INIT-007/008/009): CHK-006 mislabels registry.ts as '(MAIN_TOOLS)' when the MAIN_TOOLS array is actually exported from cli/command-catalog.ts; background.md/CHK-008 calls all three verify-process-fact-contract.mjs enumeration arrays 'MAIN_TOOLS' arrays when only the one near :1013 actually checks MAIN_TOOLS (the other two check command-policy.ts and process-fact-levels/registry.ts); and the workstream code 'W2c' in Conversational Texture is used without any definition anywhere in the story files.
